solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Various snakes crush lion, like most mammals

indicators.note: to crush in here is to squeeze another piece inside, so one set of letters is pressed into the other
to snake is to wind about, so the letters of the first word twist into a new order

parts.note: a lion is a celebrity, a very important person or VIP

explanation.surface: An assortment of snakes squeezing a lion to death, as most mammals would never do.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lion' is not the beast but a celebrity, a literary lion; the snakes shuffle around it to make VIAROUS with VIP pressed in.
explanation.definitionFit: Most mammals give birth to live young rather than laying eggs, which is the meaning of the adjective.

clue.text: Very old officer offers little force

parts.note: Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, an officer

explanation.surface: An elderly officer offers only feeble strength.
explanation.definitionFit: The unit of electromotive force; one of them is a small measure of electrical force.

clue.text: Contest involves Charlie gripping tool

indicators.note: involves means wraps in or includes, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: to vie is to contest or compete
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A competition features a man called Charlie holding a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A bench clamp with jaws that hold work firmly is a gripping tool.

clue.text: Puerto Rican rebels seizing quiet capital nearby

indicators.note: seizing means grabbing hold of, so one letter is taken inside
rebels as a verb means rises up, so the letters revolt into a new order

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet

explanation.surface: Puerto Rican insurgents take a quiet capital close by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rebels' rearranges PUERTO RICAN, and 'seizing' takes P into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Haiti's capital lies on Hispaniola, the island next to Puerto Rico, so it is a capital nearby.

clue.text: Perhaps watch over authority

indicators.note: over means turned over, so the letters are read backwards in this down clue

parts.note: a watch is one kind of timer, hence perhaps

explanation.surface: Maybe keeping an eye on someone in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'watch over' looks like a phrase meaning supervise, but 'over' turns TIMER round.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief or scope of responsibility is the authority given to a body.

clue.text: Blue Berets broadcast about dog on the loose

parts.note: United Nations peacekeepers wear blue berets

indicators.note: about means around, so the sowing word goes round the dog

parts.note: to broadcast seed is to scatter it, so broadcast means seed
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: UN soldiers spread word about a stray dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not fastened or tied down is loose, not held fast.

clue.text: It's hard work uprooting northern network

indicators.note: uprooting pulls something out, so one letter is removed from the toil word

parts.note: a grind is tedious hard work

explanation.surface: Pulling up a northern plant network is tough labour.
explanation.definitionFit: A pattern of crossing lines forms a lattice or network, as with an electricity distribution system.

clue.text: Refuse to go there to criticise bishop at home

parts.note: to rubbish something is to criticise it harshly
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
in means at home

explanation.surface: Declining to go and criticise the bishop in his own house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Refuse' reads as the verb decline, but it is the noun meaning waste.
explanation.definitionFit: Waste is put into a bin, so it is where refuse goes.

clue.text: Dark river bar's fruity confection

parts.note: dun is a dull greyish-brown, a dark colour
the Dee is a river in Scotland and in Wales
a cake of soap is a bar, the apostrophe-s standing for is

explanation.surface: A bar by a dark river serves a fruity treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish rich fruit cake topped with almonds is a fruity confection.

clue.text: Sad city opted to retain extremely rocky motorway

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles

indicators.note: to retain is to hold within, so the picked word keeps the next letters inside it

parts.note: opted means chose

indicators.note: extremely takes the outermost letters of the following word

parts.note: M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A city decided to keep a rough-surfaced motorway, which is a sad affair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' picks only the outer letters of 'rocky', and 'to retain' has the opted word holding them along with M.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means tearful or mournful, from the Latin for tears, so it is a synonym of sad.

clue.text: Retired tycoon last to leave northern port

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or gone back, so the letters are read in reverse
the final letter of the tycoon word departs

parts.note: a nabob is a wealthy, important person, a tycoon

explanation.surface: A tycoon in retirement leaves for a northern harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last to leave' takes the final B off NABOB to give NABO, which 'Retired' turns round.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a ferry port on the west coast of Scotland, gateway to the Hebrides.

clue.text: Harry speculates about writer's buried souvenirs?

indicators.note: about means around, so the rearranged letters go round the writer's piece
to harry is to harass, so the letters are worried into a new order

parts.note: the writer's is the writer is, I'M

explanation.surface: Prince Harry speculates about an author's hidden mementoes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Harry' looks like the prince's name but signals rearranging SPECULATES; it goes 'about' IM.
explanation.definitionFit: Containers of objects buried for future generations hold mementoes, hence souvenirs with a question mark.

clue.text: Nancy's tall kitchen which may attract stars

parts.note: Nancy is a French city, so this is the French word for tall or high
cuisine is French for kitchen (and cooking)

explanation.surface: A French woman's tall kitchen might draw in celebrities.
explanation.walkthrough: Nancy is the city in Lorraine, not a woman, so both words are French.
explanation.definitionFit: Refined gourmet cooking is what earns restaurants Michelin stars, so it may attract them.

clue.text: Royal pair occupy stern, getting perfect air for 23

definitions.note: air means outward look; 23 is the answer at 23-down, a form of card game

indicators.note: to occupy is to sit within, so the royal letters go inside

parts.note: po-faced is a British term for stern and humourless
K for king and ER for the queen, Elizabeth Regina

explanation.surface: A king and queen fill a sullen face, a perfect look for a card game.
explanation.walkthrough: PO-FACED means stern in British usage; 'getting' links. 23 refers to the 23-down answer, a card game where an expressionless face hides one's hand.
explanation.definitionFit: An impassive expression is ideal in stud poker, so the adjective describes the perfect demeanour for it.

clue.text: Drift across the German Serpentine?

indicators.note: across means lying over, so the drift word stretches across the German article

parts.note: the drift of an argument is its meaning
der is German for the

explanation.surface: Floating over the German version of the London lake.
explanation.walkthrough: The Serpentine is a lake in London's Hyde Park; here it is the adjective for winding.
explanation.definitionFit: Winding like a snake is what serpentine means, so a twisting course fits, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Best remaining stalag inmate very content

parts.note: left over means remaining
a stalag was a German camp for prisoners of war, POWs

indicators.note: the content of a word is what lies inside its shell, so its middle letters

explanation.surface: The finest prisoner left in the camp is very happy.
explanation.definitionFit: To best someone is to defeat or overcome them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Triumph over more modern dog-handler

indicators.note: over means covering, so the triumph word goes around

parts.note: to win is to triumph
hipper means more fashionable, more modern

explanation.surface: Beating a trendier rival to become dog-handler.
explanation.definitionFit: The huntsman's assistant who manages the hounds of a pack is a dog-handler.

clue.text: Principle of the customised integrated circuit

indicators.note: customised means altered to suit, so the short word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A principle drawn from a custom-built microchip.
explanation.definitionFit: A moral principle or code of conduct is a synonym.

clue.text: Withdrawn rabbi unnecessarily masks depression

indicators.note: Withdrawn says the hidden letters are read backwards
masks means conceals, so the letters lie hidden in the words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A reclusive rabbi needlessly hides his low spirits.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft took 'masks depression' as the definition, but 'masks' is the signal that the letters are concealed in 'rabbi unnecessarily'; IUNNE is read back by 'Withdrawn'.
explanation.definitionFit: Listless weariness and boredom is a form of low spirits or depression.

clue.text: Draw with this local in heart of Kolkata

parts.note: a person native to Kolkata is a local there, an Indian

indicators.note: the heart of a word is its central letter

explanation.surface: An instruction to sketch with something from a pub in central Kolkata.
explanation.walkthrough: 'local' looks like a pub (as in British slang), but here it is a native of the city; 'heart of' takes K from Kolkata.
explanation.definitionFit: This dense black drawing medium is used by artists for pen sketches.

clue.text: Europeans finish

definitions.meaning: two nationalities of the continent, those of Paris and Warsaw
a glossy shellac coating applied to wooden furniture

explanation.walkthrough: Read as two words it names two European peoples; as one phrase it is a wood finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Two peoples of Europe side by side, and also a lustrous shellac surface treatment for wood.

clue.text: Liberal primate admits second sin

indicators.note: admits means lets in, so a letter goes inside

parts.note: an ape is a primate

explanation.surface: A liberal-minded church leader confesses a second transgression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'primate' suggests a senior bishop, but here it is an ape.
explanation.definitionFit: A moral slip or failing is a synonym for sin.

clue.text: Just the place for a roundabout

definitions.meaning: a travelling funfair, where a merry-go-round is found

explanation.walkthrough: 'roundabout' suggests a road junction, but it is a merry-go-round.
explanation.definitionFit: Equitable treatment, and also a travelling carnival with rides such as a carousel.

clue.text: Briefly inspect Playboy

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: to study is to inspect

explanation.surface: Take a quick look at a famous magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Playboy' suggests the magazine, but it is a womaniser.
explanation.definitionFit: A man of many sexual conquests is slang for a playboy or womaniser.

clue.text: Prominent feature of short service?

indicators.note: short means cut off at the end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: a dinner service is a set of china

explanation.surface: Something that stands out in a brief church service.
explanation.walkthrough: 'service' looks like a religious one, but it is a set of crockery.
explanation.definitionFit: The jaw's front point juts out from the face, so it is a prominent facial feature.

clue.text: Secure line in factory producing explosive

indicators.note: in places the first pieces within the factory word

parts.note: a plant is an industrial factory
to rope is to tie and secure

explanation.surface: Fixing a production line in a munitions factory.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge that drives a bullet or rocket, such as gunpowder, is an explosive.

clue.text: Avoid neglecting duke and foreign magistrate

indicators.note: neglecting means leaving out, so one letter is dropped

parts.note: to dodge is to avoid

explanation.surface: Steering clear of a duke and an overseas official.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief magistrate of the old republics of Venice and Genoa held this title.

clue.text: Complete drunk conned user

indicators.note: drunk means reeling, so the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A total drunk swindled a consumer.
explanation.definitionFit: Unexpurgated material is whole and complete, with nothing cut out.
